title: 第19章 小弟天冷了姐给你加一件黄袍第20章 叶峥嵘的死因
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
lines: 李甫元愣了足足十个呼吸，大脑嗡嗡作响，飞快思考。
‘沈慕戎被一剑洞穿心脏，怎么可能没死？难道镇北王府不仅有一个武皇坐镇，还有一位医皇？’
“陛下！”
刘承恩小声喊了一句，夹杂着内力传音。
李甫元这才反应过来，目光落在沈慕戎的手里。
几个鲜血淋漓的包裹，他有一股不好的预感！
“大将军，你手里是何物？”
众人的目光，也纷纷落在沈慕戎的手里！
沈慕戎淡淡一笑：“哦，这个啊，人头。”
众人眸子一缩，面面相觑。
李甫元道：“谁的人头？”
沈慕戎回答：
“历锋将军，李虎。”
“奋威将军，钱三千。”
“虎威将军，杨子荣。”
“执金将军，宋威。”
“我命他们镇守北境，他们居然违抗军令私自回京！”
“半个时辰前，我在龙都之外三十里斩杀四人，特地来请陛下过目！”
沈慕戎将手中包裹一甩，四颗鲜血淋漓的人头滚到金銮殿中间，正是李虎、钱三千、杨子荣、宋威四人的头颅！
叶凡都吓了一跳。
看向八姐的目光，彻底变了。
更别说其他人，王国忠和六部尚书等文官，头都不敢抬，一个个呼吸急促，吓得心脏都要炸裂。
纳兰风云惊愕的目光，在沈慕戎和李甫元二人的脸上，来回转换。
东江王、南凌王、西渤王三人，更是噌噌噌的后退，三人是真的被吓到了！沈慕戎敢杀四大将军，还把人头带到金銮殿，必然也敢杀他们啊！
“咳咳……陛下，我儿子的事，算了……”
“对对对！同龄人之间打打闹闹，打断腿是很正常的。”
“陛下！我的封地还有一点公务，臣告退……”
三人抬着各自的儿子，不等李甫元回答，狼狈逃离。
万众瞩目之下，沈慕戎缓缓走到静妃的身前，露出一抹笑容，恭敬道：“静妃娘娘，您放心，镇北王世袭罔替，怎么可能造反呢？您说呢？”
静妃大气都不敢喘一口。
沈慕戎看似恭敬，但谁都看得出来，她太袒护叶凡！
“大将军说的是！”
“李幽若！”
沈慕戎突然一声呵斥。
跪在地上的李幽若，吓得一颤，一脸紧张的回头。
content_en:
Li Fuyuan was stunned for ten breaths, his brain was buzzing and he was thinking quickly.
‘How could Shen Murong not die when a sword pierced his heart? Could it be that the Zhenbei Palace has not only a Martial Emperor but also a Medical Emperor? ’
"Your Majesty!"
Liu Chengen shouted in a low voice, mixed with the sound transmission from his internal force.
Only then did Li Fuyuan react and his eyes fell on Shen Murong's hand.
There were several bloody packages, and he had a bad feeling!
"General, what is in your hand?"
Swish——!
Everyone's eyes also fell on Shen Murong's hands!
Shen Murong smiled lightly: "Oh, this is a human head."
Everyone narrowed their eyes and looked at each other.
Li Fuyuan said: "Whose head is it?"
Shen Murong replied:
"General Li Feng, Li Hu."
"General Fenwei, three thousand dollars."
"General Huwei, Yang Zirong."
"General Jin, Song Wei."
"I ordered them to guard the northern border, but they actually defied military orders and returned to Beijing privately!"
"Half an hour ago, I killed four people thirty miles outside Longdu, and I came here specifically to ask your majesty to take a look!"
Shen Murong tossed the package in his hand, and four bloody heads rolled into the middle of the Jinluan Hall. They were the heads of Li Hu, Qian Sanqian, Yang Zirong, and Song Wei!
Ye Fan was startled.
The look he looked at Eighth Sister completely changed.
Not to mention other civil servants, including Wang Guozhong and the Six Ministers, did not dare to raise their heads. They were all breathing rapidly, and their hearts were about to burst with fear.
Nalan Fengyun's shocked eyes flickered back and forth on the faces of Shen Murong and Li Fuyuan.
King Dongjiang, King Nanling, and King Xibo even retreated. The three of them were really frightened! Shen Murong dared to kill the four generals and brought their heads to the Jinluan Palace, so he must also dare to kill them!
"Ahem...Your Majesty, forget about my son..."
"Yes, yes! It's normal for peers to fight and break their legs."
"Your Majesty! I still have some official duties in my fief, so I will take my leave..."
The three of them carried their sons and fled in panic without waiting for Li Fuyuan to answer.
Under the gaze of everyone, Shen Murong slowly walked up to Concubine Jing, showed a smile, and said respectfully: "Concubine Jing, don't worry, King Zhenbei is hereditary, how can he rebel? What do you think?"
Concubine Jing didn't dare to take a breath.
Shen Murong seemed respectful, but everyone could see that she was too protective of Mark!
"That's what the general said!"
"Li Youruo!"
Shen Murong suddenly scolded.
Li Youruo, who was kneeling on the ground, trembled in fright and turned around nervously.
"Eighth...eighth sister..."
title_en: Chapter 19: Brother, it’s cold. I’ll give you a yellow robe. Chapter 20: The cause of Ye Zhengrong’s death.
